definition: For non-overlapping source and destination with API-valid byte strides aligned to double elements, caller supplies a one-pixel source halo. For finite float64 values every C1 ROI output is numerically exactly equal to the maximum of nine neighboring source values; signed-zero sign is not constrained. All destination padding remains unchanged. Null pointers, non-positive ROI size, and short byte strides return their source-defined status without writing output.
out_of_scope: byte strides not divisible by sizeof(double)
